entities.name: jwt-auth-pattern
observations: Use short-lived JWTs to limit blast radius of token theft.
Store refresh tokens in HttpOnly Secure cookies.
Include jti claim and maintain a server-side blocklist for revocation.

entities.name: rate-limiting-pattern
observations: Apply rate limits at the API gateway layer.
Use a sliding-window algorithm for per-IP limits.

entities.name: soft-delete-pattern
observations: Set deleted_at = now() instead of DELETE to preserve audit history.
Every read query filters WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.
Weekly pg_dump covers the 7-day recovery window.
